name: Immortal Sun
description: The Immortal Sun is a powerful artifact of Ixalan, a disk in Orazca that Azor made by severing his spark to imprison planeswalkers.

description_citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

description_citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
description_citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

summary.text: The Immortal Sun is a powerful artifact of Ixalan, a disk in Orazca that Azor made by severing his spark to imprison planeswalkers.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Azor severed his spark on the shores of Torrezon to create it, then waited in vain for Ugin's signal, left without a spark and a prisoner.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.
"Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

bio.text: It was stolen from the monastery by Pedron the Wicked's forces and carried west, while the vampires of the Legion of Dusk pursued it.

citations.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.
"Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.
"The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

bio.text: Azor gifted it to a monastery and then to the Sun Empire, reclaiming it each time, and sealed it within Orazca.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Kumena stepped onto it and took its power, and later Huatli, Tishana, Angrath and Vona all touched it as Vona claimed it for the Legion of Dusk.

citations.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Azor revealed it is the lock of his prison, which traps planeswalkers on a plane.

citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

bio.text: Vraska cast the spell that opened a violet portal beneath it, and it was pulled to another plane, ending the barrier on planeswalking.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.
"Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.
"Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

status.text: As of the latest story, the Immortal Sun is gone from Orazca, pulled to another plane, and the barrier on planeswalking went with it.

citations.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.
"Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds the Immortal Sun for Bolas and Tezzeret takes it away.
timeline.quote: After Vraska had found the artifact, she summoned Tezzeret, who took it away with his Planar Bridge.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Claiming the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas uses the Planar Bridge to steal the Immortal Sun and to transport his Eternals.
timeline.quote: Bolas would later use the Planar Bridge to steal the Immortal Sun and later to transport his army of Eternals during the War of the Spark.

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace becomes trapped on Ixalan by the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Jace became trapped on Ixalan by the power of the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor promises Huatli the title of warrior-poet if she finds the Golden City of Orazca, and she vows to retrieve the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The title of warrior-poet is yours if you can locate the Golden City of Orazca.

citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: A Legion of Dusk ship appears and Vraska recalls an earlier attack and the vampires' pursuit of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun was stolen from their monasteries

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Kumena argues that the River Heralds must wield the Immortal Sun themselves, while Tishana insists it must be kept unused.
timeline.quote: We must wield the power of the Immortal Sun ourselves

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk sails from Torrezon seeking glory, riches and the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Legion of Dusk sailed from Torrezon in search of glory, riches, and the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: Legion Conquistador (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Immortal Sun is taken, Angrath vanishes and reunites tearfully with his daughters at the family smithy.
timeline.quote: He then reunited, teary-eyed, with his daughters at their family's smithy.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor travels to Ixalan and sacrifices his spark to create the Immortal Sun, trapping himself there too.
timeline.quote: By this act, he also trapped himself on the plane.

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coalition reaches Orazca seeking the Immortal Sun but fails to secure it.
timeline.quote: They reached the Golden City Orazca

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "The Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pedron raids the monastery guarding the Immortal Sun; it is stolen by a winged beast and Elenda follows it west.
timeline.quote: The monastery was raided by Pedron the Wicked , who killed most of its occupants.

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Warrior nun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath tells Huatli he seeks the Immortal Sun and in their battle her spark ignites.
timeline.quote: In their battle, her spark ignited

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Ignited yet unawakened". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun and a current of energy rushes through them.
timeline.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret steals the Immortal Sun through a planar portal.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret stole the Immortal Sun through a planar portal

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor creates the Immortal Sun by imbuing it with his spark, trapping himself and preventing planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Azor created the Immortal Sun by imbuing it with his planeswalker's spark

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hostile forces under Pedron the Wicked attack the monastery in Torrezon; Azor takes the Sun across the sea to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: The Sun was taken by Azor, and he brought it across the sea to the continent of Ixalan

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Torrezon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire builds Orazca around the Immortal Sun until an emperor misuses it, and Azor makes the Empire leave the hidden city.
timeline.quote: As a consequence, Azor caused the Empire to leave the city.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Sun Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire abuses the Immortal Sun's power, fracturing its balance with the River Heralds and pushing the empire toward the coasts.
timeline.quote: until its abuse of the artifact’s power fractured that balance

citation.text: "Ixalan (continent)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor creates the Immortal Sun in 3279 AR to trap Nicol Bolas, preventing planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Azor created a powerful artifact known as the Immortal Sun to trap Nicol Bolas .

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Pedron the Wicked steals the Immortal Sun from its monastery but Azor reclaims it.
timeline.quote: stole the Immortal Sun but lost it to Azor, who reclaimed it

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Apatzec Intli I uses the Immortal Sun without restraint in a devastating war with the River Heralds.
timeline.quote: who had gained possession of the Immortal Sun and used it without restraint

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun is stolen and removed from the plane by a henchman of Bolas, breaking the barrier.
timeline.quote: was stolen and removed from the plane by a henchman of Bolas

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska hires Malcolm to serve aboard the Belligerent in search of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Malcolm was hired by Captain Vraska to serve aboard the pirate ship Belligerent in search of the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Malcolm Lee", section "Race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Apatzec Intli is gifted the Immortal Sun and misuses it; the city is ruined and abandoned, and the Sun passes to the River Heralds.
timeline.quote: He wielded the artifact without any wisdom or restraint, and the city was ruined.

citation.text: "Orazca", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska uses Bolas's spell and Tezzeret seizes the Immortal Sun through a planar portal.
timeline.quote: Vraska used the spell taught to her by Bolas, resulting in the Sun being seized through a planar portal by Tezzeret .

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion's first expedition to Ixalan ends in disaster with the second loss of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Legion of Dusk's first expedition to Ixalan would end in disaster: a humiliation at Orazca, the second loss of the Immortal Sun, and Elenda's chastising of the Legion upon her return to Alta Torrezon.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "First expedition to Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret steals the Immortal Sun and removes it from Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the artifact was stolen by Tezzeret and removed from the plane

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska summons Tezzeret, who removes the Immortal Sun from Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Vraska summoned Tezzeret

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Malcolm explains the history of the Immortal Sun, stolen from Torrezon and carried west.
timeline.quote: a winged being descended from the sky. It took the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace discuss what the Immortal Sun might do, joking about Lord Nicolas.
timeline.quote: Maybe Lord Nicolas is a rock collector?

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Kumena nears Orazca using little magic to avoid Tishana.
timeline.quote: He was nearing the golden city of Orazca, the resting place of the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: A voice from the golden walls calls Kumena to set it free.
timeline.quote: Kumena the Shaper, child of the Great River, leader of your people. Come set me free.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena realizes the voice is his own reflected power.
timeline.quote: The voice was deep and commanding, the voice of a leader. It was his own.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The voice calls itself the Sun and tells Kumena to follow it through the labyrinth.
timeline.quote: I am the Sun, Kumena. As you will be.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena reaches the central tower and finds the Immortal Sun embedded in the floor.
timeline.quote: He stepped into the chamber, and beheld the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kumena steps onto the Immortal Sun and takes its power.
timeline.quote: Kumena stepped onto the Immortal Sun and took that power, his power.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The struggle for control of the Immortal Sun plunges the world into darkness under a blood-red sky.
timeline.quote: As the struggle raged for control of the Immortal Sun, the world grew dark under a blood-red sky.

citation.text: Blood Sun (Rivals of Ixalan Promos, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: With Kumena in control of the Immortal Sun, the rapids rise and the waterfalls take flight.
timeline.quote: With Kumena in control of the Immortal Sun, the rapids rose from their riverbeds and the waterfalls took flight.

citation.text: Soul of the Rapids (Rivals of Ixalan, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Legion explorers reach Orazca and ransack tombs and temples hunting for the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Once they reached Orazca, the Legion's explorers ransacked tombs and temples, hunting for the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: Dusk Legion Zealot (Rivals of Ixalan, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The opening of Orazca unleashes horrors beyond the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: Ravenous Chupacabra (Rivals of Ixalan, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elenda finds the Immortal Sun at Orazca and sleeps in a tomb of Aclazotz until the city awakens.
timeline.quote: she put herself in an enchanted sleep in a tomb of the bat-god Aclazotz

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Sanctum of the Sun she refuses Mavren Fein's request to retrieve the vanished Immortal Sun, tells the vampires they are free, and rebukes Vona.
timeline.quote: Elenda refused, telling the vampire that they were finally free from their ancient duty

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A brawl erupts in the chamber and everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Fight for Control". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska summons Tezzeret, who spirits the Immortal Sun off the plane, revealing Bolas's plan to invade Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret used the Planar Bridge to spirit the Immortal Sun off the plane.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Theft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli concludes the Legion of Dusk has taken control of the Immortal Sun and the city.
timeline.quote: the Legion of Dusk had taken control of the Immortal Sun

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Tishana burst into the Sun chamber and Vona claims the Immortal Sun for the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: I am Vona, Butcher of Magan, and the Immortal Sun belongs to the Legion of Dusk!

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli realizes the Immortal Sun is a disk set into the floor.
timeline.quote: the disk could only be the Immortal Sun.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona uses the Immortal Sun to turn Huatli's blood against her.
timeline.quote: Vona was using the Immortal Sun to manipulate her blood.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli, Tishana, Angrath and Vona all touch the Immortal Sun and a surge of energy passes through them.
timeline.quote: The four of them gasped as an immense current of energy passed through them.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor calls the Immortal Sun the lock of his prison and Vraska realizes it is what traps planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: The lock of my prison, my finest creation.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor reveals the Immortal Sun imprisons planeswalkers and that he gave up his spark to make it.
timeline.quote: I gave up my spark to help create the Immortal Sun, the lock of my prison, my greatest gift to all living things.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor outlines creating the Immortal Sun on Ixalan to summon Bolas, at the cost of his spark.
timeline.quote: I will build the Immortal Sun there, on the continent of Torrezon.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor severs his spark on the shores of Torrezon to create the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: severing his spark to create the artifact he called the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor waits in vain for Ugin's signal, left without a spark and a prisoner.
timeline.quote: Azor was left without a spark, and his prison without a prisoner.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Azor gifts the Immortal Sun to a monastery and then to the Sun Empire, reclaiming it each time.
timeline.quote: He gifted the Immortal Sun to a monastery that would later give rise to the Legion of Dusk

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska casts the spell that opens a violet portal beneath the Immortal Sun, which is pulled to another plane.
timeline.quote: when a violet circle opened up directly beneath the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun is pulled away and Vraska planeswalks off Ixalan.
timeline.quote: As the portal closed, Vraska planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun vanishes and Huatli, Tishana, Vona and Angrath fall into the room below.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun vanished beneath their feet

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli realizes both the Immortal Sun and the barrier are gone.
timeline.quote: Both the Immortal Sun and the barrier.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Vona cries out that the Immortal Sun is gone.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun is gone!

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda explains her order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not use it, and that she sealed herself away here.
timeline.quote: Our order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not to use it.

citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Bolas that the Immortal Sun will trap him and Baishya says they hear the artifact; Bolas, fearing the bluff may be true, strikes the canyon and flees.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun is pointed here, at this very spot on Tarkir.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova explains that Bolas could not risk it being true, and Baishya says there really was a plot to trap Bolas, but Ugin died before activating it.
timeline.quote: There was a plot to trap Bolas using the Immortal Sun.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas rewards Vraska with the location where Jarad is imprisoned after the Immortal Sun affair on Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Pleased with the planewalker Vraska 's role in securing the Immortal Sun in Ixalan , Nicol Bolas rewarded her with the information where Jarad was imprisoned.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Guilds of Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas activates the Immortal Sun, trapping planeswalkers on Ravnica for the Elderspell.
timeline.quote: when Bolas activated the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug", section "Interplanar Beacon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon, Angrath is trapped by Bolas's Immortal Sun and fights the Eternals, pulling some to his side with controlling magic.
timeline.quote: he could temporarily pull Eternals to his side during the fight, allowing him to amass a miniature army.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath chooses to remain on Ravnica after Chandra disables the Immortal Sun and helps the Gatewatch against Bolas.
timeline.quote: Angrath was one of the few planeswalkers who chose to remain on Ravnica

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the battle Angrath wants to destroy the Immortal Sun but is vetoed, and tells Teyo to pity the loved ones left behind.
timeline.quote: telling the boy not to pity the dead – for their suffering is over – but rather to pity the loved ones they left behind.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra helps disable the Immortal Sun, allowing many Planeswalkers to leave Ravnica.
timeline.quote: This deception allowed the real Chandra to sneak into Baan's facility and disable the Immortal Sun, allowing many Planeswalkers to leave Ravnica.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As part of Gideon's plan, Chandra reactivates the Immortal Sun to keep Bolas from planeswalking away.
timeline.quote: she reactivated the Immortal Sun to prevent Bolas from planeswalking away

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack is lured back to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and trapped by the Immortal Sun, then fights the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the War of the Spark, Lazav, disguised as Chandra, blinds Dovin, who planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Lazav threw throwing stars that hit Dovin in the eyes and blinded him.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch arrives on Ravnica and is trapped by Bolas's use of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: they immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon is trapped on Ravnica by the Immortal Sun and fights the Dreadhorde with the Boros.
timeline.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra so the real Chandra can disable the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Lazav disguised himself as Chandra, which allowed the real Chandra to disable the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "House Dimir", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Saheeli are lured to Ravnica and trapped there by Bolas's use of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Huatli and Saheeli were lured back to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and immediately became trapped there
